posts.title: Questions from outsider. What to do at the allotment during winter?
posts.content: Good point, but in fact there is a lot of preparative work going on by the end of the year. Obviosly digging - first and most imporntant, prunning. Also good time to plant garlic :) my favourite spice!

posts.title: My shed my rules :)!
posts.content: Building a shed on the allotment is a great start when you aquire a plot. I got one for free in bits. A bit rusty but a lot of paint sorted it.

posts.title: Rain water collection.
posts.content: Two simple gutters and upcycled waterbutts and you got free water - downpipes might be made from 2 liter plastic bottles cut and put together - photos to follow.

posts.title: Tomatoes on the vine!
posts.content: It took some effort over the dry days but what a result!

posts.title: Fresh gherkin.
posts.content: Seeds from pomeranian region in Poland!

posts.title: Turning red on the vine :)
posts.content: Not many people had red ripe tomatoes this season - what’s the secret ❤️?
